title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a shared logical writing family preserves necessity direction across two domains
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Use complete tin and nourishment passages to constrain one domain-general logical family: necessary support is not success, and an internal alternative is not a conjunction or interchangeable aid. The new contract requires predictive lexical/compositional reuse across domains instead of independent modal operators assigned to each source story.

design.scope: Prospective meaning constraint. No manuscript observation, target nomination, decoder, experiment or confirmation is performed.
design.access: Existing cached source prose and finalized predecessor reports only. No new target content, images, source fetch, reserve, admission or contact. f84/f84r remain sealed.
design.structural_baseline: Word spaces and directed reusable parts are evidence; a learned segmentation is not one proven morpheme parser. Whole-form residuals GDT608 remain. No EVA/BPE alphabet, default language or English whole-word dictionary is selected.
design.retention_not_readiness: RAW retention does not assert that source agreement, word identity or target correspondence is established. Root must inspect full primary predecessors and freeze selection independently.
design.hypothesis: One small written family, provisionally equivalent to without/requires/if depending on source language, contributes the same implication direction and constituent scope across complete exposition units. Source grammar supplies the logical readings before any target assignment. Whole-form lexicalization is allowed if explicitly paid; productive decomposition must predict nonseed forms rather than being asserted.
complete_source_units: Whole Steele Mediaeval Lore id00105, Tin in fire departeth... through Neither may these be soldered without grease or tallow.

Whole Galen Natural Faculties III.9 p277 paragraph in the cached 1916 translation, ending before III.10; retain attraction/rejection, named-organ generalization and concluding dog/liver-residue analogy.
source_claims: Lead may not be SOON soldered to lead/brass/iron without tin; the speed qualification belongs to the consequent condition.
The named soldering cases may not be soldered without grease OR tallow; this does not make grease a substitute for tin or require both alternatives.
Galen says four faculties are necessary for every part to be nourished. Mere possession is not an asserted successful nourishment event.
source_reading_grid: JOIN -> (GREASE OR TALLOW); not JOIN -> (GREASE AND TALLOW), and no asserted exclusive-or.
NOURISHABLE/PART_TO_BE_NOURISHED -> HAS_EACH_FOUR_FACULTIES; the modal rendering remains open, and the source does not assert a current event from ability.
design.decision_changing_consequence: The same fixed lexical construction must preserve the direction of entailment in both domains. A nonseed complete consumer stating only the required resources cannot license a later success assertion through this operator; a consumer explicitly lacking a required resource cannot still assert the qualified enabled outcome under the same scope. These are proposed lexical entailment checks, not observed world tests.
rivals: Sufficient recipe or activation instruction with explicitly stated background conditions; do not caricature all procedural rivals as guarantees in unconstrained worlds.
Biconditional dependency, which adds the unsupported converse.
Flat list conjunction that erases qualified soon, necessity, or the internal OR.
Independent domain-specific modal whole words with no common writing family; remains admissible if the manuscript offers no shared form.
new_contract_vs_predecessors: IDEA603 and its B_SECOND_SUPPLY note already preserve soon, OR and necessity versus sufficiency. No new soldering content is claimed.

IDEA553 already assigns a six-word necessity seed. CONTENT_OPERATION_SUPPLY explicitly retains it without a new card, and warns that a truth table repeating the operator definition is not a target experiment. Here NONE of those target values is inherited; the proposed new constraint is one source-fixed logical lexical family reused across different complete domains, plus a nonseed assertion whose commitment depends on the operator.
GDT899/908 exact house-condition writer remains excluded. This proposal neither repairs its compiler nor recodes its 24 source records. A source-specific code fit is not the new endpoint.
precise_new_measurement_needed: From the already cached witnesses, freeze the source grammatical constituent boundaries and all licensed necessity/sufficiency/modal alternatives; English translations do not select the target language.

Root would need to nominate an existing admitted complete target pair with an exact shared whole or prospectively specified compositional form family and two independent written antecedent/consequent uses. Counts, list lengths and shared aiin alone cannot nominate the connective.

A third complete nonseed consumer must separately express resource presence/absence or outcome assertion under the unchanged lexical key. Its relation to the surrounding assertion, not an analyst-programmed Boolean, supplies the possible falsifier. No such target binding is supplied here.
design.changed_falsifier: Freeze at most four source-licensed logical readings and one writing/morphology key before the nonseed consumer. Reject necessity if unchanged lexical derivation reverses the dependency, conflates OR with AND, drops soon, or requires a special domain/type cast or invisible success event. Retain ambiguity if both readings give the same commitments or all predicates remain freely bound. A hand-authored truth table is not evidence.
known_limits: Necessity and the tin OR are already raw knowledge; novelty is only the explicit shared lexical entailment contract. If no shared target construction can be nominated, existing603/553 remain the better offers and this card is not ready.
Galen disposition, action and result are distinct. Generic part-to-be-nourished is not simply an observed nutrition event.
Tin has contrasting operation effects and unresolved quicksilver pronouns. Full-paragraph duties cannot be dropped to make a two-clause fit.
No finite local alias dictionary, BindRecord renaming, hidden transaction, or per-source typed operator counts as cross-domain reuse.

smallest_future_step.decision: Continue only if one unchanged form-family rule carries different dependency claims in complete units; otherwise retain raw without a decoder or target expansion.

design.mechanism: One logical writing family preserves implication direction and constituent alternatives across metallurgy and physiology.

design.contrast: Necessary aid versus sufficient instruction or biconditional; internal grease-or-tallow versus conjunction and soon versus unqualified outcome.
design.prediction: A common unchanged writing family must retain the same dependency direction and distinguish separate later resource or success assertions.
design.falsifier: Freeze at most four source-licensed logical readings and one writing/morphology key before the nonseed consumer. Reject necessity if unchanged lexical derivation reverses the dependency, conflates OR with AND, drops soon, or requires a special domain/type cast or invisible success event. Retain ambiguity if both readings give the same commitments or all predicates remain freely bound. A hand-authored truth table is not evidence.
